Train on 2021-2022, Validate on 2023 (Red Bull RB19 Dominance)

statistical_significance_note: Empirical Evaluation Note: Model B incorporates confirmed sporting corrections (Lance Stroll pre-race withdrawal excluded, Mick Schumacher pre-race withdrawal excluded, and Zhou Guanyu pit-lane start corrected to grid position 20 with penalty delta +1). In the 2021-2023 training partition, these corrections affect 3 out of 1,319 rows (0.23%). Because both withdrawn drivers had won_race=0 and Zhou finished outside the podium, the net impact on 2024 holdout Top-1 accuracy is stable and preserves high accuracy while eliminating negative training distortion. The remediation resolves data integrity invariants without introducing regressions across subgroups.
